_about: Data for scripts/check-docs.mjs. reference: the chapter numbers and appendix letters the reference must hold (D6). ratchet: exact counts over docs/reference (D8); when one falls, lower it to the number the check prints, never raise it. The seeds are the whole single-file manual before the split, measured by ratchetCounts. history: sha256 of each frozen file in docs/history (D9); null until the file is committed. nameAllowlist: backticked UPPER_SNAKE names the operator pages may use that are not option keys (D4); each must occur as a string literal in server/src (docsLayout.test.ts).
